## Key Coverage Dossier

### 1. Bitcoin Monetary & Market Dynamics
- Bitcoin cleared $89,000 driven by spot ETF net inflows crossing $3.2B weekly.
- OTC desks report liquid supply dropping under 30% of total circulating volume.
- Over 68% of circulating BTC has not moved in over 12 months.

### 2. Ethereum & Layer-2 Scaling
- Layer-2 throughput exceeded 2,500 TPS across Arbitrum, Base, Optimism, and ZK-rollups.
- Average L2 transaction fees stabilized below $0.005 post-blob optimizations.
- The Pectra upgrade implements EIP-7702 account abstraction and EIP-7251 MaxEB validator balance consolidation.

### 3. Stablecoins & MiCA Regulation
- The European Union MiCA regulation enforces 100% segregated high-quality liquid asset reserves for licensed token issuers.
- USDC circulating volume crossed $42B driven by corporate B2B cross-border trade routes and Circle CCTP interoperability.

### 4. Solana & DePIN Networks
- Solana TVL crossed $12B with Firedancer independent C++ validator client achieving 1M TPS synthetic load benchmarks.
- DePIN projects (Helium, Hivemapper, Render) demonstrate crowdsourced capital expenditure efficiency over legacy telecom.

### 5. Institutional Asset Allocation
- Average target allocation for digital assets in balanced endowment portfolios rose to 4.5%.
- FASB fair-value accounting standard enables public companies to record quarterly market value adjustments.
